title: Quick Chinese Pasta Stir Fry
description: A fast Chinese-inspired pasta dish made with quick-cooking ingredients.
instructions: 1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook pasta according to package instructions.
2. While pasta cooks, heat dum sauce in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
3. Add chopped scallions and grated ginger to the wok and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes.
4. Drain cooked pasta and add to the wok, stirring to combine with sauce and vegetables.
5. Sprinkle with italian seasoning and serve immediately.
6. Garnish with additional scallions if desired.
